# Reverse the encoding
alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"
expected = "0yauzm7ytg0o_g8uw10"

# For each char in expected:
# expected_pos = (input_pos + 7) % 37
# So: input_pos = (expected_pos - 7) % 37

for c in expected:
    expected_pos = alphabet.index(c)
    input_pos = (expected_pos - 7) % 37
    result.append(alphabet[input_pos])

flag = f"FLAG{{{flag_content}}}"

print(f"Full flag: {flag}")
